title: Sep 27 Results: 85.7% Hit Rate Across 14 Games
summary: 12-2 record on Sep 27 with strong performance across all confidence tiers

## The Numbers Tell the Story

Let's break down September 27th by the data. We posted a 12-2 record across 14 games, hitting at an 85.7% clip. That's 5.7 percentage points above our season baseline and represents one of our stronger days in the past two weeks.

## Confidence Tier Analysis

Here's what stands out: our 60%+ confidence picks went 5-1, while the 50-59% range delivered 7-1. The Guardians pick at 61% was our only miss in the high-confidence tier—that's a 83.3% conversion rate where it matters most.

## Miss Analysis: What Went Wrong

Two misses on the day. The Rays at 54% fell to the Phillies—a coin-flip game that went the other way. More interesting is the Guardians miss at 61%. Cleveland entered as our second-highest confidence play but couldn't execute against Kansas City. Looking at the underlying metrics, the Royals' bullpen efficiency rating was 12% higher than our model weighted—a variable that swung the outcome.

## Best Calls of the Day

The Mariners pick (61%) delivered exactly as projected. Our model identified a 23% platoon advantage and Seattle's bullpen posted a 0.87 WHIP over the final four innings—right in line with our pre-game projections. The Dodgers-Giants call at 59% also hit cleanly, with LA's offense producing 1.4 runs above their seasonal average.
